text:
Maya: Quick sync — final checklist for the microlesson webinar tomorrow AM. Priorities: registration consent language, replay delivery timing, and lead routing to HubSpot. I updated the reg page draft: https://landing.redwood.ai/microlesson — please review the privacy checkbox copy.

Sam: Saw the draft, looks good overall. Quick question — do we need explicit double opt-in for EU (GDPR) or is checkbox + confirmation email enough?

Jia: Checkbox + confirmation email (single opt-in with explicit consent text) should be fine for marketing replay. I'll add a hidden utm field to the form to help segmentation. Also proposing the consent copy: "By registering you agree to receive the replay and occasional product updates. You can unsubscribe at any time."

Leo: Zoom settings we should enforce: record to cloud, separate files per participant, enable auto-transcript, disable attendee annotation, and make sure the "participants must consent to recording" prompt is on. I'm going to lock those in.

ZoomBot: Reminder — cloud recording scheduled for 2024-05-02 09:00 UTC. Recording will be processed and available ~15-25 minutes after the meeting ends.

Maya: Perfect. Sam, can you map the HubSpot workflow? Need tags: microlesson-registered, microlesson-attended, microlesson-watched-25, microlesson-watched-50, microlesson-watched-100. Also add a field for consent_gdpr boolean.

Sam: On it. Plan: form submit -> tag microlesson-registered -> send confirmation email immediately -> if attendee detected (Zoom webhook) tag microlesson-attended -> send attendee follow-up with CTA. For non-attendees send replay after 1 hour. I'll wire video provider webhook for watched percentages if possible.

Jia: For the replay UX: produce a short 3–5 minute highlight clip plus full recording. For paid trial leads include a 1:1 booking CTA in the replay email; for others, CTA to benchmark blog + gated asset. Ops — we need captions (SRT) and a QC pass.

Leo: @Ops can you handle SRT extraction and QC? Plan: run automated transcript export -> quick human pass -> add speaker labels. Put final assets in /Marketing/Microlesson/Recordings on GDrive.

Ops: Yep — we'll run the pipeline. Using ffmpeg + whisper-prod export then a quick spot-check. Our ETA is 45 minutes after recording processing completes. We'll push the SRT and QC report to the folder.

Maya: One more privacy/note: make sure EU registrants see the consent line on the form and we capture consent_gdpr. Jia, confirm the exact copy used?

Jia: Confirmed. Use: "We will email you the replay and occasional product updates. You may unsubscribe at any time. By registering you consent to receive these emails."

Sam: Also a small ops note: Zoom sometimes splits the recording into multiple files; include a concat step in the pipeline. I'll add a script snippet to the runbook: 
```bash
# concat parts if split by Zoom
ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i parts.txt -c copy full_recording.mp4
```

Leo: Thumbs up. Sam — can you also ensure we generate 1:1 and 16:9 thumbnails for social and email? We need a 1200x628 and a 1080x1080 version.

Sam: Yep. I'll add thumbnail generation and upload to the asset folder. Also adding HubSpot flow: send replay to attendees at +30m, registrants who didn't join at +1h, and a final nudge at +48h for non-openers.

Maya: Any risks or missing pieces?

Jia: Risk: caption accuracy on auto-transcript for technical terms. Ops, please flag any heavy mis-transcriptions and we'll add manual corrections.

Ops: Will do. We'll sample 10% of dialogue lines and escalate any term with >20% confidence drop.

Leo: Another tiny ask — enable "recording disclaimer" in Zoom participant join screen so attendees see the consent message.

Maya: Great. I'll finalize the runbook now and share the link here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

Sam: Nice — going to add the HubSpot playbook doc after this. :rocket:

Jia: Replied with wording approval.

ZoomBot: Recording complete (automated): meeting ended at 2024-05-02 10:02 UTC. Processing started.

Ops: Processing done, SRT draft uploaded to /Marketing/Microlesson/Recordings/srt_draft.srt — starting QC.

Maya: Amazing, thanks team. I'll follow up with the runbook link in the channel and ping when emails go out. :partyparrot:
